plate_comment: Requests logical output 16 (the transmission control relay: its read-back faults are P0883 / P0882 'TCM power input high / low') while the engine is not stopped and none of the relay / solenoid circuit limp bits is set (e2m RE_Trans_Relay_Circuit_Open, RE_Governor_Press_Sol_Circuit, RE_Overdrive_Solenoid_Circuit, RE_Lockup_Converter_Clutch_Solenoid_Circuit); otherwise drops the relay, which puts the 48RE in limp-home (was cm848_evaluateProtectionFaultCondition)

Sets the e2m 8C19 limp-home bits from the fault bits: limp_home_flags_1 0x01 RE_Trans_Relay_Circuit_Open (fault 137 P0882), 0x02 RE_TPS_Elect_Limp (the pedal faults P2121 / P2122 / P2123 / P2127 / P2128 and P0698); limp_home_flags_2 0x01 RE_Governor_Press_Sol_Circuit (351 P0748), 0x02 RE_Overdrive_Solenoid_Circuit (139 P0973); limp_home_flags_3 0x01 RE_Gov_Sensor_Limp_Circuit (299 / 300 P0868 / P0869, or the P1762 monitor failed); limp_home_flags_4 0x10 RE_Lockup_Converter_Clutch_Solenoid_Circuit (141 P2769) (was cm848_processProtectionFaultSeverity)

Input step of the transmission controller: mirrors the converter clutch and overdrive solenoid requests (outputs 18 / 17) into the transmission flags, and while no actuator or service test runs sets transmission_normal_operation_flag, copies cruise engagement into mode_flags 0x10 and computes transmission_4th_gear_lockup_boost_pressure (gauge, or absolute minus barometric pressure); clears the flag while a test runs (was cm848_evaluateProtectionModeFlags)

State phase of the transmission controller (phase group B, after cm848_selectTransmissionTemperatureInUse): when the transmission control is enabled (algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal bit 2) it updates the inputs, and in normal operation the timers, the current gear and lockup inhibit, the condition flags, the output shaft acceleration and the transmission relay request (was cm848_processCalibrationTablesMain)

Control phase of the transmission controller (called right after cm848_updateTransmissionControlState): runs cm848_runTransmissionControl and cm848_selectGovernorPressureLockupBoost when the transmission control is enabled (algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal bit 2) and transmission_normal_operation_flag is set (was cm848_processProtectionStateMachine)

Initializes the P1756 / P1757 governor pressure tracking monitor (cm848_monitorGovernorPressureTracking): both check states (e2m 8C58 +2 / +8) to not run, the mid-range fault reported flag and the rate divider to 0 (was initHpcr_FaultCounters)

Initializes the alternator field controller: the lookup caches, the regulator state, the duty / PID terms, the charging voltage condition timers, the field cut test (and its fault bits 368-370), then enables the field output driver from alternator_field_output_channel_cal (was cm848_initProtectionFilterValues)
